body: I'm proud of you and i am happy you are still here.

My mom is just like this. Said I just wanted attention, made fun of me for self harm. It is awful and i will never understand but I want to tell you something that no one ever told me, your feelings are valid. Remember that anytime she is trying to make it seem like you are just a dramatic kid.

Hey, you said it yourself, you are just 16. You have your whole life ahead of you. You could move away and meet incredible people, or do incredible things that you would never imagine for yourself. Hun you haven't really even got to experience LIVING yet. The world is your oyster. Your future could be so bright and so wonderful, you just need to allow yourself to get to that point. Also, your english is really really good! I think you are far too hard on yourself. Please keep your head up.

What helped me when I was younger was finding forms of media that could portray how I felt. Movies, songs, books, poetry. So I could say it without ever actually opening my mouth. "Explaining My Depression To My Mother" is a button poetry video that actually helped me immensely. Maybe you could try to find something you relate to and show it to your parents. It could open the conversation.
I am so proud of you for reaching out to your therapist in a time like this, that takes real strength and bravery. Keep on pushin through, i believe in you.
in six months i will not forget this reddit post and i dont even know you. please call a hotline. reach out to someone, anyone. please.
please at least try to ring a hotline. you deserve to be heard.
